items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I saw it on a picture of a film poster for a film called “Ring of Fire” with Dwayne Eddy doing the soundtrack and Frank Gorshin as the villain.

ctx.x: Yeah I didn’t know, I found out afterwards. I saw it on a picture of a film poster for a film called “Ring of Fire” with Dwayne Eddy doing the soundtrack and Frank Gorshin as the villain. It’s about a cop taking a hostage through a burning forest and the blurb on the thing says “Minute by minute” the something and it just stuck in my head and I went oh I’m having that. That just sounded good. And I checked, before I wrote it I checked to see if anyone had written one called that and Doobie Brothers had and I…
I googled that phrase. I said to myself what does that mean.
